assertions.name: every_realistic_basis_is_entropy_blocked_at_both_sigma_readings
assertions.source: D_eff(alpha) = 5.61427 digits even under the OVER-OPTIMISTIC sigma(Q) = 7.8e-9, against floors of 9.2041 (n=4, H<=100) and 13.806 (n=6, H<=100). Any closed form matched to alpha_required over a basis of 4+ terms is guaranteed-spurious, by the PR #1805 bound that already forbade the c_3 PSLQ route.

assertions.name: even_the_minimal_basis_fails_at_the_honest_experimental_sigma
assertions.source: at sigma(Q) = 7.8e-7 (the experimental value) D_eff(alpha) = 3.61427 digits against the cheapest floor 3.90309 (n=3, H<=10) — short by 0.2888. The minimal basis clears only under the optimistic sigma, which nobody claims. NOTE: this probe first asserted a BLANKET block (best-case D_eff < cheapest floor) and that FAILED — 5.61 > 3.90. The phase is not as noise-starved as c_3; the licence is narrow, not absent.

assertions.name: the_amplifier_on_the_phase_is_cotangent_not_one_over_u_cubed
assertions.source: cot(alpha_eff_req) = 17.643569 at the proton anchor. The phase is NOT amplified by 1/u^3 (that is the c_3 rung's amplifier, proved exactly in QOU.QBeta.c3Of_sub_mul_u_cubed); it is amplified by cot, because the ladder reads it through the flat part of the cosine. Two different amplifiers, and conflating them would misattribute the phase's noise budget.

description: Bean qou-cds1, formalize-first prune. Asks of the ladder PHASE the question PROBE 4 asked of c_3: how many reliable digits does the inverted target carry, and does that clear the PSLQ entropy floor n*log10(2H)? cos(alpha_eff_req) = Q_codata/(Q_A(1-u^2)) means sigma(alpha_eff) = cot(alpha_eff)*sigma_rel(Q_beta), and cot is large because alpha_eff is small — the ladder reads the phase through the flat part of the cosine. Evaluated at both anchors and at BOTH sigma(Q_beta) readings in the corpus (7.8e-7 experimental and an over-optimistic 7.8e-9) so the prune survives the friendliest input. Also explains the apparent anchor-stability of alpha_required: a quantity with this few digits cannot resolve a cross-anchor difference. Derives nothing and forbids only that one route; deriving alpha categorically is untouched and remains open.
